label: Capture
title: Field data capture
desc: Terrestrial scanning, UAV photogrammetry, and multibeam bathymetry — collected by your field crews or ours, tied to a documented control network.

label: Point cloud
title: Registration & cleaning
desc: Scans registered to project control, noise removed, and points classified into ground, structure, and vegetation — with registration reports you can hand to the owner.

label: Model
title: Mesh & model extraction
desc: Dense meshes and structural elements extracted for BIM coordination, clash review, and as-built modeling.

label: Verify
title: Design verification
desc: As-built surfaces compared against design intent. Deviations are flagged, quantified, and reviewed by a licensed surveyor before anything leaves the office.

label: Deliver
title: Client deliverables
desc: Submittal-ready drawings, as-built documentation, models, and written reports — formatted to your project specifications and agency requirements.
